tools.name: recommend_apps
tools.description: Ranks the apps in the AppFinder directory against a plain-language request and explains each pick with cited facts (what fits, what's missing, which apps a must-have rules out), plus one follow-up question that would narrow the list.

tools.name: search_apps
tools.description: Full-text search of the directory by name, keyword or job (most relevant first).

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: One app's listing: description, categories, pricing, platforms, features, integrations, rating and its facts with sources.

tools.name: compare_apps
tools.description: Side by side: pricing, and the features, integrations and platforms both apps have or only one has.

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Apps that do what an app does (same category, most shared features first), and what buyers who wanted to replace it chose.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The directory's categories with how many apps each lists.

tools.name: category_demand
tools.description: The public demand report of a category: the share of buyers who asked the advisor for each feature, integration, security need and budget in the last 90 days (anonymous totals), and how many listed apps answer each.

tools.name: check_listing
tools.description: Whether a website already has a published AppFinder listing, and its page. Call this before prepare_listing.

tools.name: prepare_listing
tools.description: For a maker who wants to list their own app: fills in AppFinder's submission form from what they told you plus the app's website, and returns a private link. The person opens it, signs in, reviews every field and submits; nothing is published until AppFinder's team approves it. Listing is free. Pass

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_listing · Private data: prepare_listing · Public sink: category_demand.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_listing · Private data: prepare_listing · Public sink: category_demand

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
